root_idea.summary: The root centers on joining or sharing something so that it is not exclusive to one party; a secondary branch denotes extension and linear spread.
root_idea.development: The first branch develops into participation, partnership, making someone a partner, and religiously attributing a partner to God. The second develops into road tracks, sandal straps, and hunting snares through the ideas of extension and connected lines.

senses.definition: To share or participate with another; to become a partner or associate in an affair.
senses.usage_conditions: Takes a person or party as the partner and may be followed by فِي for the affair, property, or matter shared. Quranic usage includes being made a partner in another's affair.

senses.definition: To make someone a partner, associate, or participant in an affair.
senses.usage_conditions: The person made a partner may be introduced as sharing in an affair, sale, property, or other matter; the Quranic construction وَأَشْرِكْهُ فِي أَمْرِي exemplifies inclusion in an affair.

senses.definition: To attribute a partner or partners to God; to associate another with Him in worship or divine prerogative.
senses.usage_conditions: This is the Quranic theological construction أَشْرَكَ بِاللَّهِ and includes treating another as sharing God's exclusive divinity. Lexically, unbelief may be described more broadly as a form of this association.

senses.definition: A partner, co-owner, associate, or colleague sharing a thing, affair, right, or dominion.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quran commonly uses the plural شُرَكَاء for alleged partners of God and for parties treated as sharing authority or possession.

senses.definition: Sharing, participation, partnership; a share or portion in something.
senses.usage_conditions: The noun can denote participation between parties or an allocated share, including a share in property or an affair.

senses.definition: Religious association: attributing a partner to God or sharing religious devotion or regard with another.
senses.usage_conditions: In theological usage this includes the great shirk of affirming a partner for God and the more hidden association described as ostentation or hypocrisy in some religious acts.

senses.definition: One who attributes a partner or partners to God; a polytheist.
senses.usage_conditions: This active participle is substantivized for people characterized by associating others with God. The feminine forms مُشْرِكَة and مُشْرِكَات are included under this headword.

senses.definition: A disbeliever in God, in the widened lexical sense that unbelief entails a form of shirk.
senses.usage_conditions: This is an extended usage related to the primary sense of polytheism; Quranic contexts most directly identify the person who associates another with God.

senses.definition: Sharing or participating jointly with others; a co-sharer.
senses.usage_conditions: The active participle describes parties who share or participate together in a matter; the Quranic occurrences are plural and substantivized.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To share or participate with someone in a sale, purchase, inheritance, affair, or other matter; to become his partner.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction may also mean to enter or engage with another in an affair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a sandal: for its sandal strap to break.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized intransitive use concerning the sandal and its شِرَاك.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To sell a part or share of something one has purchased for the price or purpose for which it was purchased.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A commercial technical use of the verbal noun تَشْرِيكٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put a sandal strap on a sandal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive sandal-making or repair construction; the alternative Form IV expression is also reported in the same lexical discussion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To share, participate, or become a copartner with another in something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reciprocal Form VIII verb describes mutual or joint participation between parties.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A word shared by several meanings; a homonym.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical lexicological use of مُشْتَرَكٌ, literally something participated in by multiple meanings.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For an affair or case to become confused or dubious.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Lane marks this as an assumed figurative extension.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A snare or set of snares for catching wild animals, birds, or other game.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The collective noun may refer to the cords or devices composing a trap; its plural is also reported as شُرُكٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The main or middle parts of a road, its conspicuous tracks, furrows, or branching lesser tracks.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may refer either to the distinct tracks made in the road or to branch tracks that leave the main road and terminate.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A piece or portion of flesh-meat shared among people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dialectal usage, especially reported of a slaughtered camel and the people sharing it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Quick and consecutive movement or action; a rapid repeated striking or coming to water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The adjective can describe a quick pace, consecutive slapping, or repeated prompt arrival.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The thong or strap on the upper face of a sandal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may include the arms of the strap attached near the sides of the sandal; its plural is شُرُكٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Streaks or discontinuous rows of herbage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension describing vegetation occurring in separate strips rather than continuously.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A row of shoots or offsets cut from palm trees and planted.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized agricultural usage reported in connection with planted palm offsets.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A uniform line, manner, or arrangement.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative expression for proceeding in one consistent way or making an affair uniform.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A spouse, beloved woman, or a person related through marriage, such as a son-in-law.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The specialized usage may call a man's wife or object of love شَرِيكَة and may use شَرِيك for a man married to another's daughter or sister.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A technical inheritance case in which maternal half-siblings and full siblings are made to share a portion together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also called the مُشَرِّكَة, مُشْتَرَكَة, حِمَارِيَّة, حَجَرِيَّة, يَمِّيَّة, or عُمَرِيَّة case in the reported terminology.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wind nearer to the crosswind than to either of the two winds between which it blows.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical description of an intermediate wind direction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Shared or common rather than reserved exclusively for one person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a road open to common use or to a worker whose services are available to successive clients rather than held exclusively by one employer.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The faculty said by philosophers to be participated in by the five senses; common sense in popular usage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical philosophical expression distinct from the ordinary meaning of مُشْتَرَكٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a man, talking to himself as one affected by anxiety or troubled judgment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An assumed figurative use in which his judgment is described as shared or not unified.

The wider senses of أَشْرَكَ and مُشْرِك involving unbelief are lexical extensions recorded alongside the primary Quranic sense of associating partners with God.
The masculine, feminine singular, and feminine plural active-participle QAC groups for مُشْرِك are presented under one normalized lexical headword.
